findings.claim: M11 V2 est prêt pour la montée 5→10
findings.reason: M11 V2 execution and post-run semantic audit have not yet demonstrated the promotion gate; current scaling gate remains HOLD/DENY.

findings.claim: M11 V2 a été conçu pour apprendre efficacement
findings.reason: Design intent is not measured learning performance.

evidence_bound_summary.learning_state: AÉLYS currently benefits from verified memory/versioning and SPIRALIX transport; AÉLYS-specific neural learning is not proven.
evidence_bound_summary.learning_speed: Infrastructure and memory integration have progressed quickly, but cognitive learning speed is not yet measured.
evidence_bound_summary.learns_well: Structured routing, memory continuity, role separation and evidence transport are demonstrably functioning.
evidence_bound_summary.needs_improvement: Semantic fidelity and resistance to prompt/example drift remain weak in the current shared-model executions.
evidence_bound_summary.recommended_next_step: Execute M11 V2, audit it, and scale 5→10 only if semantic fidelity measurably improves.
